topic: UGC Ad Generator Landing Page (AEO/SEO) — Hub + 10 Subpages
target_audience: Performance marketers, DTC/ecommerce founders, and UGC creators who need UGC-style short-form video ad scripts, shot lists, and rapid creative variations for testing on TikTok/Reels/Shorts.
page_goal: Rank for UGC ad intent queries, educate on what UGC ads are and how to produce them, and convert high-intent visitors into generating a first UGC ad script (one free preview) → signup → export video variants.

not_assumed: voice cloning as a core promise
product_assumptions.gating_rule: Allow 1 script preview without login; require signup for exporting and multi-variant generation.

must_include: HowTo in 3 steps (input → generate script/shot list → export variants)
At least 6 copy-paste script + shot list templates
Compliance section (no impersonation, disclosure, platform policies)
JSON-LD snippets (FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList; optional VideoObject)
must_avoid: Claims about capabilities Alici does not ship
